description: A row whose FILLER is not blank, which is the sharpest test of what DISPLAY CUSTOMER-RECORD writes. The verb names the 01 group item, so it emits the record area as READ ... INTO left it - and the trailing 168 bytes of that area hold whatever the row held, because CVCUS01Y declares no field over them and this program never writes the file. A translation that rendered the decoded record instead of the stored bytes would allocate a fresh area, emit that span as 168 spaces, and differ from this expectation on both of the record's two display lines and on its final-state row. The other 332 bytes are the first row of the shipped fixture unchanged, so only the property under test varies.
